name: movie-watchlist
description: A full-stack MERN application for managing your personal movie collection. Track movies you want to watch, are currently watching, or have already watched — with priorities, ratings, genre filters, and statistics.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
